questions.q: What did Admiral McRaven do to help Afghan women share information with U.S. forces?
questions.why: McRaven formed female teams to gather intel from women.

questions.q: Which event motivated James Patrick Allison to pursue cancer research?
a: Losing his mother and uncles to cancer
questions.why: Allison lost family members to cancer, inspiring his work.

questions.q: What type of cells did Allison study for cancer treatment?
questions.why: Allison focused on T-cells to fight cancer.

questions.q: How many enemy soldiers were killed during the Green Berets' rescue mission?
questions.why: The firefight resulted in 42 enemy casualties.

questions.q: What was a major obstacle to Allison's cancer drug entering the market?
questions.why: Companies were unwilling to support his new drug.
